origin.description: Replaces each missing character with a string, "NA" by default.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: A single string. The default is the text NA, not a missing value.

origin.details: Missing values become replacement. Every other value is coerced to character and kept. Names on the input are kept.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.

translation.description: Replaces each missing character with a string, "NA" by default.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings, numbers, logical values, and stringi._na.NA.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: One string. The default is the text "NA". A missing replacement is an error.

translation.details: Calls stringi.stri_replace_na. Numbers and TRUE or FALSE are coerced to character first. Names on the input are copied onto the list.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringr.replace import str_replace_na
for item in str_replace_na([NA, "abc", "def"]):
    print(item)
